notes.base: New base: arm A is upstream dev 62eaa9dc249b67567b9cbc83e43fbc875a8b94c1 ('Merge pull request #2142 from JustVugg/docs/coffee-line'); the 2026-10-15 manifests (../final/pr1) used dev 7b55a9b3792527f52d1a2337fd9e312b9a7983e3. The pr1 tip 7e9d2d20816398c25dc979e952ce924cc1012fc3 (rb/pr1/reap-prefill, tree 2de8c223fc1188ce5c60d628028af704184395a0) is 21 commits on top of this base (meta/tips.txt: dev_is_ancestor_of_pr1=yes). dev still refuses the batched GPU MoE for the 132-expert model: every A serve.log has 'v4_gpu moe-batch=off (unsupported model geometry)', every B/C serve.log 'v4_gpu moe-batch=on bank=132-experts', and only C 'v4_gpu moe-double=on'.
notes.prewarm: Expert-cache prewarm: the base includes upstream #2111 (463f8443, 'a serve fills the expert cache before its first request (#2109)'), so both dev and the pr1 tip prewarm at serve start. At --ram 40 the plan holds 59 of 132 experts per layer, so the prewarm picks experts from .coli_usage, which was empty (size 0, same mtime) before and after every sample (sample.txt usage_before/usage_after; summary.json usage_history_changed []). Every A/B/C serve.log says '[v4] expert cache: 59 of 132 experts per layer fit and no usage history says which, so it fills as experts are used': the prewarm read nothing, and the expert cache started empty in every sample as on 2026-10-15.
notes.warmup: warmup_runs 1: request 2 (long_prefill_2) is served by the same server process right after request 1 (long_prefill, the 1992-token prompt, max_tokens 100), which is its one warm-up here; request 1 is itself measured, in the matching -1992 manifest
